scope: Frozen offline reference qualification and label audit on twelve previously selected 90-second blocks, not a fresh security evaluation or policy improvement. No predictor fitting, threshold search, clock offset fitting or live reference use.
primary_reference: Horizontal speed hypot(north_velocity,east_velocity) in m/s, from INSPVA; three-dimensional magnitude retained only as a secondary grade-sensitivity diagnostic. This is not body-frame longitudinal velocity.
matching: Latest INSPVA header timestamp <= radar scoring endpoint; maximum age 100ms; strictly ordered unique headers per topic; no interpolation, future samples or timestamp-offset optimization. Bag timestamp preserved as an offline writer diagnostic, not evidence of live availability.
quality: Only status INS_SOLUTION_GOOD (3) with finite velocities and nonnegative integer timestamps is usable. No post-result substitution of other statuses. All existing endpoints remain in the denominator; unmatched/invalid reference and missing channels reported separately.
uncertainty: INSPVAX latest header <= endpoint, max age 1.5s; report component standard deviations and status separately. Standard deviations and empirical quantiles are not worst-case error bounds; never use them to qualify a live witness.

primary_diagnostic_targets.applies_to: Every existing recording and 90-second block; diagnostic only, not proof of a uniform bound or journal readiness.

metrics: OBD and GNSS-associated disagreements vs same offline reference
speed-bin context by offline reference only for audit, never policy input
reference_lineage: Dataset authors describe post-processed Novatel PwrPak7-E1 GNSS + KVH1750 IMU. GNSS ancestry overlaps a compromised channel; offline processing is noncausal. It cannot establish attack-independent online authenticity or a formal worst-case bound.
source_integrity: Download entire reference.bag for each role, verify captured publisher SHA256, retain whole bags for independent offline hash/replay. This verification is only for the four reference bags, not for earlier partial radar/OBD/GNSS downloads.
qualification: A live witness requires independently supported raw/configured units, geometry, threat-independent lineage, authenticated provenance, trusted live time/freshness, physical uniform error and acceleration bounds. Missing or empirical-only bounds fail closed. Existing production witness remains disabled.
timing_bound: Conditional ideal model only: B=epsilon+a_max*age_s; speed hypotheses for shifts delta require delta>2B to be disjoint. Necessary condition under this scalar observation interface, not a measured or complete system guarantee.
forbidden: Refitting predictors from newly opened reference labels
Tuning timing offsets from comparison errors
Calling reused recordings new held-out evidence
Promoting P95, observed maximum, sigma or 3sigma to a uniform bound
Modifying production certificate or session gate
